day.title: Frost Goblins Ambush
day.text: 3 Frost Goblins leap from behind a snowbank demanding your supplies!

day.title: Sudden Blizzard
day.text: Temperatures plummet rapidly. DC 12 Constitution save or suffer 1 level of Exhaustion.

day.title: Wandering Merchant
day.text: A shivering fur-trader offers rare potions in exchange for warm rations.

day.title: Dire Wolf Tracks
day.text: Fresh wolf prints circle your path. DC 13 Wisdom (Survival) to avoid a surprise attack.

night.title: Ice Specter Attack
night.text: A freezing mist takes humanoid form. The temperature drops below zero as a specter attacks!

night.title: Cultist Patrol
night.text: 2 Sewer Cultists carrying dark lanterns spot your light in the darkness.

night.title: Eerie Distant Howls
night.text: Chilling howls echo through the valley. The party feels watched from the dark.
